seo.title: Election site in 3 days, €0, two cycles · №04
seo.description: Static-first Astro build for a district election — zero budget, reused across two cycles; the client won round two.

rail.role: Sole designer & developer; layout/colors chosen with client

index.title: Election campaign site — Astro, 3 days, €0
index.summary: A static site built in 3 days for €0, reused across two election cycles.

headline: Three days, zero budget, two election cycles.

hero.alt: The deniztoastmasters.com homepage: Deniz Şenelt Kalelioğlu's headline and platform statement beside her portrait, with a Let's Connect button and a nav linking to Strategy, Highlights, Promises, Biography, and Testimonials.
hero.caption: The homepage — headline, platform statement, and portrait.

problem: A friend running in a competitive district-level Toastmasters election had no web presence beyond social media. The election date was fixed; a credible, professional site had to exist fast.
constraint: €0 build budget (the client covers only the annual domain renewal), a turnaround tied to the election date, requirements and assets arriving over WhatsApp, and no technical staff on her side after launch.
decision: Static-first, zero-cost, zero-maintenance: Astro + Tailwind, Cloudflare for the domain, free Vercel hosting with GitHub auto-deploy, one fully responsive page with optimized assets and semantic markup. Layout, colors, and typography chosen together with the client; built and deployed solo in ~3 days.

figures.alt: A fresh Lighthouse audit of deniztoastmasters.com in Chrome DevTools: 100 scores for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO, plus a 2/2 Agentic Browsing check, above the live homepage it audited.
figures.caption: Fresh Lighthouse run — 100 across every category.

figures.alt: A grid of testimonial cards from Toastmasters International Presidents and district leaders, including Ted Corcoran (International President 2003/2004) and Mohammed Murad (International President 2014/2015).
figures.caption: Testimonials from Toastmasters International presidents.

figures.alt: The Highlights section: Program Quality Director role goals beside a photo of Toastmasters recognition certificates, above a 'Contribution to District 109 so far' list.
figures.caption: Highlights — role goals and District 109 contributions.

evidence.caption: A fresh Lighthouse run under stable conditions: 100 across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO, alongside the testimonials and highlights sections it audited.

result.label: RESULT
result.metrics: LAUNCHED IN ~3 DAYS · €0 · TWO ELECTION CYCLES
result.body: Launched for the 2025 election — she lost that round. The site was refreshed and reused for 2026, when she won the Program Quality Director role. A zero-cost, low-maintenance build that carried real stakes twice.

lesson: A fast, zero-cost, low-maintenance site can carry real stakes when timing matters — and this one wasn't a one-off; it served two election cycles.
